einzeiler: Lindsay Clancy's defense, Luigi Mangione's plea, and an expert look at ghost guns.
kurzfassung: In Massachusetts, the defense calls witnesses in the trial of Lindsay Clancy, who is accused of killing her three children while suffering from postpartum psychosis. In New York, Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson while his lawyers seek to dismiss state murder charges. Additionally, an expert explains the role of ghost guns and silencers in criminal investigations.
stichpunkte: Defense witnesses in Lindsay Clancy's trial testify about her severe postpartum mental deterioration and daily suicidal thoughts.
Colleagues and family members describe Clancy as a compassionate nurse and an involved mother who begged for help.
Luigi Mangione pleads guilty in federal court to stalking charges related to the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson.
Mangione's defense team files a motion to dismiss state murder charges based on New York's double jeopardy protections.
Alec Murdoch returns to a South Carolina courtroom for a pretrial hearing regarding venue and the admissibility of his previous testimony.
In Florida, the trial begins for Mario Fernandez-Saldana, one of three defendants charged in the murder of Jared Bridegan.
Jared Bridegan's widow, Kirsten, and a witness who found the victim's two-year-old daughter in the car testify.
Retired ATF special agent Derek Pleasance explains how ghost guns and silencers impact criminal investigations.
beschreibung:
In Massachusetts, Lindsay Clancy is on trial for allegedly murdering her three children. Her family and former colleagues testify for the defense. In New York, Luigi Mangione pleads guilty to federal stalking charges in the killing of UnitedHealthcare CEO Brian Thompson, while his lawyers seek to have the state murder case dismissed. In Dateline Round Up, Alex Murdaugh appears for a preliminary hearing ahead of his retrial for the murders of his wife and son. Plus, the trial begins for one of three people accused in the ambush murder of 33-year-old father Jared Bridegan. And an expert explains ghost guns and how they can complicate investigations.

This episode discusses suicide. If you or someone you know is in crisis, call the Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 or visit 988lifeline.org for more resources.
